item.coloph: rol pa che chung gnyis kyi rgyud phyag bla mas so sor zur du bkod pa yod kyang / bdag gis gnyis po mnyam du bsgrigs pa 'di/ dge'o//

khro bo rol pa'i rgyud phyag 'di/ bka'ud che chung gi phyag ni/ bla ma'i zur yig rgyud phyag yod mod kyang / nyer bsgrig mu tig phreng ba 'di ni/ gal te ma legs nyes 'gal byung srid na/ skyabs gnas yul mchog gnas bzhi mkha' 'gro dang/ bka' skyong dam can rnams la bzod par gsol/ bkra shis dge legs 'phel 'gyur cig
